name: market-mcp-composer
description: Read-only market research workflows backed by the Market MCP Composer, including FinViz ticker lookup and normalized market snapshots.

interface.shortDescription: Read FinViz data and normalized market snapshots from Market MCP Composer.
interface.longDescription: Read-only market research workflows for FinViz lookup and normalized market snapshots. On ChatGPT web, register the remote MCP endpoint in Developer mode before combining it with skills.
defaultPrompt: Look up MSFT using FinViz and summarize the returned fields.
Get a normalized market snapshot for MSFT and SPY and report source-quality metadata.
Show the external broker requirements declared by the market snapshot without placing a trade.
